description: Computes, on the lots the user gives (ticker, shares, price, date, account and its type), the losses a sale before December 31 would realize and what they offset, with the engine of Portfolio Terminal's "Before December 31" panel. US resident: FIFO lots per account, short vs long term, this year's realized gains, the year netted as Schedule D nets it (the $3,000 off ordinary income, the carryforward), and the wash-sale rule across every account, IRA and 401(k) included: losses it took this year, windows still open, and the first day the same security can be bought back without one (IRS Publication 550). French resident: weighted average cost across accounts at ECB rates, PEA and crypto left out, and the flat tax those losses erase against this year's net gains (CGI art. 150-0 D, 200 A). Funds on the same index are flagged, never judged "substantially identical". Current prices are fetched unless given in `prices`. Nothing is stored. Use it for "how much tax can my losses save before December 31", "would this be a wash sale".

carryover.description: US only: capital losses carried into this year from last year's return, in dollars, by term.

filing_status.description: US only: Form 1040 filing status (default single). Married filing separately caps the deduction at $1,500.

lots.description: Every purchase of the shares held, one per lot; add this year's sales (side "sell") with the purchases they came from, so realized gains and wash sales count. At most 300.

account.description: The account's name, e.g. "Schwab", "Fidelity Roth IRA", "Boursorama PEA". Lots with the same name are one account.

account_type.description: taxable (US brokerage), ira (traditional IRA), roth_ira, 401k (any workplace plan), pea (French PEA) or cto (French compte-titres). Default: what the account name says, else taxable/CTO.

currency.description: Currency of `price` and `fee` (default: the listing's currency).

date.description: Trade date, YYYY-MM-DD. Needed for a sale, and for wash sales and short vs long term (US). Without it a holding is valued at its cost and its term is unknown.

price.description: Per share, in `currency`: what was paid for a buy, what was received for a sale.

side.description: buy (default) for shares bought, sell for a sale already made.

ticker.description: The ticker as the broker lists it: "NVDA", "VOO", "MC.PA", "IWDA.AS".

prices.description: Current price per share by ticker, in the lots' currency, when the user gave it. Tickers left out are priced from Yahoo Finance. At most 150.

residence.description: Where the user pays tax: US or FR (France).

name: tax_loss_harvest
title: Tax-loss harvesting before December 31
